admission.justification: Spans grammars version pins, PinnedDependencyTests guard, recorded-anchor qualified lookup, and shared extents holder containment, guarded by dependency-pin and shared-containment tests.

applicability: Tree-sitter dependency pins in grammars.MEASURED_VERSIONS and qualified symbol lookups in read_anchors._defining_extents and extents.qualified_spans.
conditions: grammars.MEASURED_VERSIONS aligns tree-sitter at 0.26.1 alongside pinned grammar packages matching pyproject.toml bounds, uv.lock, and installed wheels.
PinnedDependencyTests verifies every measured version and default provider query compilation without dead OFFLINE_PROBE code.
read_anchors._defining_extents delegates to extents.qualified_spans so recorded-anchor reads apply the same enclosing-holder containment as writer and conversion.
exclusions: Exact-binding providers such as Lean resolve exact keys only and do not apply dotted holder containment.
statement: PinnedDependencyTests verifies MEASURED_VERSIONS against pyproject.toml bounds, uv.lock (aligned at tree-sitter 0.26.1), and installed wheels; dead OFFLINE_PROBE is deleted; and read_anchors._defining_extents shares extents.qualified_spans holder-containment semantics.
title: Pinned grammar versions match lock/wheels and read_anchors shares containment
